why: Overlap is judged on a control's whole box again, so a control scrolled out of view inside its container 'overlaps' whatever is drawn where its box would be. Measured on the Controllers pane with two pads at 1280x800@200%: the unsupported pad's button, scrolled below its rows container, failed the required visual check for overlapping the pane's Back button, which a press there reaches.
killedBy: menu hit-target verdict (issue #686) judges overlap on the visible part, so a control scrolled out of its container does not overlap one outside it (issue #766)
